import sys, random, time, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import build_plan, verify_plan, find_cut

random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 12345)
N = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 400
bad=0; noplancut=0; both=0; plans=0
t0=time.time()
for it in range(N):
    n = random.randint(3,6)
    nlinks = random.randint(1,7)
    pairs = random.sample(list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2)), min(nlinks, n*(n-1)//2))
    links=[]
    for (u,v) in pairs:
        links.append((u,v,random.randint(0,3)))
    k = random.randint(2, min(n,4))
    parts = sorted(random.sample(range(n), k))
    demand={}
    for v in range(n):
        demand[v]=0
    tot=0
    for v in parts:
        if random.random()<0.8:
            demand[v]=random.randint(0,2); tot+=demand[v]
    if tot==0:
        demand[parts[0]]=1
    linkuv=[(u,v) for (u,v,c) in links]
    cap=[c for (u,v,c) in links]
    plan = build_plan(n, linkuv, cap, parts, demand)
    cut = find_cut(n, linkuv, cap, parts, demand)
    if plan is not None:
        plans+=1
        if not verify_plan(plan, n, linkuv, cap, parts, demand):
            print("INVALID PLAN", it, links, parts, demand); bad+=1
        if cut is not None:
            print("BOTH PLAN AND CUT", it, links, parts, demand, cut); both+=1
    else:
        if cut is None:
            print("NO PLAN NO CUT", it, n, links, parts, demand); noplancut+=1
print(f"iters={N} plans={plans} bad={bad} both={both} noplancut={noplancut} time={time.time()-t0:.1f}s")
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/stress.py 1 300
